name: Saint Petersburg
summary_text: Mixed record: the dismembered remains of a gender-nonconforming person who sold sex and was murdered in the region (26 February 2025) were found in the city, and the case was prosecuted - arrest within days, a strict-regime colony sentence of 11 years on 9 September 2025 - although press coverage was mocking and misgendered. Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): the country's most European city; window-to-Europe legacy, underground scene. Scored relative to the national score (0.12) for Russia.

sources.title: Russia: Rising Toll of LGBT ‘Extremism’ Designation | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch report (30 June 2025) on the rising toll of the 'extremism' designation against LGBT people: courts have issued over 100 convictions for participating in the 'international LGBT movement' or displaying alleged symbols, with administrative and criminal charges used in a broader crackdown to enforce 'traditional values'.
